renderContract.commonPrompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: premium work-next-move action-beat guardian card master artwork, full-bleed 3:4. Show exactly the named single guardian or canonical internal pair; no extra guardian, coworker, client, recipient, human, silhouette, reflection, empty seat or personal belonging implying another person. Preserve canonical identity, colors, clothing, signature props, dark-purple eyes and visible chest Stella stars. Guardian or pair plus one next-step control covers 55–65% and reads at 80px. Capture only the first bounded planning motion while the completion edge remains visibly open; never guarantee completion, promotion or future success. Written surfaces use isolated symbols and geometric reliefs only: no readable text, pseudo-text, names, labels, score, number, date, clock face, calendar grid, map coordinate, question mark, zodiac glyph, arrow route, logo or watermark. Do not bake actual birth-chart lines or personal colors into the master art. Controls remain removable, half-set, open-ended or unlatched. Only Scorpio canonical tail-heart is allowed; no added heart. No closed ring, portal, infinity sign or deterministic route. Keep every composition distinct. Soft colored-pencil and watercolor, paper grain, plush proportions and deep-purple outlines; no readable text, no logo, no watermark.
